checkpoint_contents: pair count and sample hash chain
early_stopping: None by loss or validation. Stop safely on nonfinite loss/gradients, integrity drift, resource failure or active-time cap; an incomplete endpoint is never accepted.
gradient_accumulation: Deterministic two-pass gradient cache: concatenate detached microbatch predictions, differentiate one full logical-batch cosine and grouped variance loss with respect to that bank, then recompute each model microbatch and backpropagate its exact feature gradient. Verify identical recomputed predictions. One clip/optimizer/scheduler update per logical batch.
initialization: Fresh matched core seed20260925 and JEPA projection seed20260926; pinned base Qwen, no trained Pixel/B0/diagnostic/pilot weights.
loss_rationale: Use the Step 3 verified cosine + 10*anchor-grouped teacher-relative variance objective. Weight10 was the only tested weight to learn the original controlled action-order task; verified real overfit passed. Freeze before production without held-out predictor tuning.

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: linear warmup then cosine to minimum; last training update at minimum

order_rule.mixing: round-robin two anchors per episode in each four-episode pool until exhausted
order_rule.tail_rule: retain all short batches and valid near-end horizons; never pad/drop/repeat
order_rule.targets: every h with anchor+h<L; both cameras
order_rule.weighting: equal future pairs and equal camera/RGB pixels

pilot.cache_check: Fill all target frames of the largest metadata-selected pool; verify cache hits, fresh canonical replay and empty-cache recomputation exactly. Measure 20 40-pair all-hit gathers.
pilot.projection: p95(current features+two-pass update+warm data+40-pair cache gather)*all updates + p95(target time/cache misses)*all unique target frames + p95 cold decoding/episode*all episodes + checkpoint overhead; multiply by1.5; require under60h, active cap72h. Include target cache in host-memory stress check.
pilot.resume_comparison: bitwise state-content equality for model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG, cursor, exposures and sample chain against separate uninterrupted process
pilot.selection: Evenly spaced episode pools plus longest episode and longest instruction; fill duplicate extreme selections by ascending pool index

pixel_comparison: Reuse this exact one-pass ordered anchor/horizon plan, logical batches and pair exposure. Reuse the exact 4,238,592-parameter future core; report the 392,835-parameter pixel decoder separately. JEPA has its separately declared target/objective and resource pilot.

precision.loss: FP32 whole logical-batch cosine and grouped variance
precision.targets: BF16 frozen canonical vision output, detached FP32 normalization and loss

target_encoding: Accepted v2 Qwen frozen image-only single-camera vision calls. Lazy exact FP32 targets keyed by (episode,target_frame) in the active four-episode pool; discard RAM cache on pool change/restart and recompute. No rounded or persistent target cache.
variance_rule: Average horizons sharing (episode,anchor), then population std across distinct anchors at each fixed camera/spatial/channel, sqrt(2048) scale, epsilon1e-4; mean relu(0.5*teacher_std-pred_std). Every pair equal in cosine. A singleton anchor has exactly zero variance penalty; keep all short batches.
